Callout.Name: Missed Dialysis
Callout.Message: Person unwell after missing a dialysis appointment.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, swollen, hospital trying to contact them.

Script.Line: The transport did not come. It did not come and I could not get there on my own.
I can barely stand up. My legs are like paper.
Do not touch this arm. That is the fistula. Do not touch this arm.

Callout.Patient: I could not get there. I could not get there.

Lines.Approach: He has missed two appointments and his body is telling everybody about it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
